newsitem.title: UK: IBCA raises Fleet Financial Group ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA raises Fleet Financial Group ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Tuesday it had upgraded Fleet Financial Group's long-term rating to A from A minus, and its short-term rating to A1 from A2.

It said it had also upgraded the long-term ratings for the company's main banking subsidiaries, Fleet National Bank, Fleet Bank NA and Fleet Bank (NY) to A plus from A. It added the bank subsidiary short-term ratings of A1 were unchanged.

IBCA said that aided by the acquisitions of Shawmut in December 1995 and the U.S. banking operations of Natwest in May 1996, Fleet had strengthened its banking franchise in New England and established a good presence in New York and New Jersy.
"The company has also improved its risk profile over the past few years as a result of better funding, profitability and asset quality," IBCA said in a statement.
"Fleet still faces some challenges fully assimilating the acquisitions but as it focuses on generating efficiencies and synergies, IBCA expects that positive performance trends will continue."
